mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has fallen in three consecutive weeks (-14.0 to -26.0). This downward momentum in foot-traffic habituation will persist, keeping the next 4-week mean below the prior 4-week mean absent any offsetting shock.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC declined every week from t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: Next 28-day mean RETAIL_REC exceeds the last 28-day mean despite three or more consecutive weeks of decline at the decision point.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp week-on-week contraction in WORKPLACES mobility signals active restriction tightening (e.g. work-from-home mandates) that reduces discretionary trips chained to commuting, dragging RETAIL_REC down over the following 2 weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES falls more than 15 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES dropped from -21.9 to -40.3 between t-2w and t-1w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to decline or rises within 2 weeks after a WORKPLACES drop exceeding 15 points.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL mobility rises while TRANSIT mobility simultaneously falls, households are substituting home-based activity for outings that require transit, compounding to suppress RETAIL_REC over the next 4 weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL rises and TRANSIT falls in the same week for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL rose from 9.7 to 16.9 while TRANSIT fell from -10.0 to -26.7 over the same four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next 4 weeks despite RESIDENTIAL increasing and TRANSIT decreasing concurrently for two or more weeks.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT mobility falling below -25 percent indicates severe restriction on movement infrastructure, which mechanically limits access to retail and recreation destinations, keeping RETAIL_REC suppressed over the following 4 weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT reached -27.7 at t-1w and -26.7 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC's next 4-week mean exceeds its last 4-week mean while TRANSIT remains below -25 percent throughout the observation window.

mechanism_narrative: Persistently elevated GROCERY_PHARM mobility (35-55 percent above baseline) reflects a recurring stockpiling/panic-buying pattern that substitutes for general retail outings, pulling RETAIL_REC down over the next week.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM stayed between 35.6 and 55.1 across all four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises in the week following sustained GROCERY_PHARM readings above 35 percent.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS mobility has remained roughly flat (-19.3 to -21.1) even as RETAIL_REC fell sharply, indicating outdoor recreation is a stable substitute activity while indoor retail trips continue to erode over the next 2 weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS week-on-week change stays within 2 points while RETAIL_REC falls more than 5 points
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS varied only within -19.3 to -21.1 while RETAIL_REC fell from -14.0 to -26.0
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC stabilizes or rises over 2 weeks even though PARKS remains flat and RETAIL_REC had been falling more than 5 points per week.

mechanism_narrative: The pace of RETAIL_REC decline decelerated from -9.2 points (t-2w to t-1w) to -1.1 points (t-1w to t-0w), suggesting the contraction is bottoming out and a mean-reversion rebound will lift RETAIL_REC over the next 4 weeks.
candidate_trigger: RETAIL_REC week-on-week decline shrinks to less than 2 points for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC weekly change slowed from -9.2 to -1.1 points between the last two observed weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC continues to decline or stays flat over the next 4 weeks despite the deceleration observed at t-0w.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous sharp declines in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT in the same week signal coordinated restriction tightening (e.g. lockdown measures) that jointly suppress mobility to retail destinations within the following week.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both decline by more than 10 points in the same week
evidence_refs: fact:Between t-2w and t-1w WORKPLACES fell 18.4 points and TRANSIT fell 12.6 points simultaneously
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall in the week after a joint WORKPLACES and TRANSIT decline exceeding 10 points each.
